question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.
sql:
WITH word_sigs AS (
  SELECT words, LENGTH(words) as len, string_agg(c ORDER BY c) as sorted_chars
  FROM word_list, unnest(split(words, '')) AS t(c)
  WHERE words LIKE 'r%'
    AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND words IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY words, LENGTH(words)
),
anagram_groups AS (
  SELECT words, len, sorted_chars, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY len, sorted_chars) as anagram_count
  FROM word_sigs
  QUALIFY COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY len, sorted_chars) > 1
)
SELECT words, anagram_count
FROM anagram_groups
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10
